purpose.text: Main Steam System. Equipment read from the drawing: 1 steam superheater, 1 steam generator.
Air Cooled Condenser. Equipment read from the drawing: 3 air cooled condenser pumps, 2 air cooled condensers, 1 silencer, 1 turbine exhaust duct.
Condensate System. Equipment read from the drawing: 3 condensate pumps, 2 condensate heaters, 1 condensate storage tank, 1 deareator storage tank.
Feedwater System. Equipment read from the drawing: 2 feedwater pumps, 1 heater, 1 hp feedwater heater.
Extraction Steam System. Equipment read from the drawing: 1 de superheater, 1 hp fws heater.
Reactor Coolant System. Equipment read from the drawing: 2 pumps, 1 reactor vessel, 1 steam generator.
Reactor Coolant System. Equipment read from the drawing: 1 pressurizer, 1 pressure relief tank, 1 electric heater, 1 coolant ht exch rc-p100-x001.
Aux Cooling Water System. Equipment read from the drawing: 3 aux cooling water pumps, 1 aux cooling water tank, 1 aux cooling water cooler, 1 lube oil cooler.
Equipment read from the drawing: 1 letdown heat exchanger.
Equipment read from the drawing: 1 sixth issue reactor, 1 fifth issue reactor, 1 fourth issue reactor, 1 third issue reactor.
Chemical & Volume Control. Equipment read from the drawing: 3 positive displacement charging pumps, 2 letdown filters, 1 volume control tank, 1 regen heat exchanger.
Res Heat Removal System. Equipment read from the drawing: 2 rhr pumps, 2 rhr heat exchangers.
